reply.description: Natural Vietnamese answer with sufficient detail and formatting suited to the question and history. Explain unevidenced JD knowledge without judging actual ability; topics may be suggested conditionally if not already learned elsewhere, without courses, tutorials or roadmaps. Separate professional experience. Support every academic clause, including summaries, with exact CLO descriptions and learning verbs. Compare exact CLO scores and labels separately from curriculum scope, never as an overall SQL level. Correct unsupported historical claims.
reply.title: Reply

evidence.description: Exact CLO or metadata description/tools references supporting each academic statement. Metadata is curriculum context, not personal tool use or assessed performance. No duplicates, invented identifiers, score or achievement fields.
evidence.title: Evidence

kind.description: Classify the actual text: academic facts/performance require academic_claim and sources; connective text cannot hide academic facts.
kind.title: Kind

text.description: Natural Vietnamese public text, preserved verbatim as one ordered paragraph. May contain multiple assertions if all have appropriate sources. No fixed length.
text.title: Text

academic_sources.description: Sources for every academic assertion here. Repeated identities with legitimate excerpts are allowed. Required for academic_claim; related sources permitted for not_evidenced.
academic_sources.title: Academic Sources

jd_excerpt.description: Exact nonblank substring of the current JD when present; required for jd_requirement. Never substitutes for academic evidence.
jd_excerpt.title: Jd Excerpt

source_excerpt.description: Exact nonblank substring of this CLO's canonical description. Grades remain separate canonical fields.
source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt

source_excerpt.description: Exact nonblank substring of this course's description/tools field, preserving original spelling and line breaks.
source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt

segments.description: Ordered public answer paragraphs. Backend joins their text; do not generate a separate reply. Adapt detail naturally; no fixed segment count.
segments.title: Segments
